scope: NRF snapshots only; historical SX SSMS schema2 and all its bytes remain supported and unchanged
payload: not all zero or all FF
validation: PersistentStorage_ObjectRead must accept the outer CRC32/generation/length first. MissionRadioProfile_Read validates header/tag/version/length/ranges into a private candidate and publishes only once on success. This parser alone does not validate the other sections or their hashes.
integrity: Unmodified bounded PersistentStorage atomic slot/bank mechanism; outer CRC32 over object header prefix and payload; section FNV hashes remain in section0.
legacy: Reader schema2 returns the exact historical 15-byte SX profile without reinterpretation. Unknown schema/backend/version are explicit errors. No fallback LoRa defaults.
